Rotate into IRSX and PMUI for leveraged upside, as global semis (AMZN, 9984) validate the cycle. Trim MSKY if it lags next week; hold through Q3 earnings for further re-rating.

Local retail participation in IDX mining names amplifies small-cap volatility (ALKA, FPNI), but institutional flows favor large-cap liquid plays, widening the quality-versus-speculation spread.
sectors.ai: Buy selective nickel/tin names (INCO, TINS) on Indonesia's downstream export ban stickiness and China stimulus spillover; trim ALKA/FPNI momentum spikes as retail froth. Watch US rate repricing risk, but IDX energy resilience signals local liquidity. Position for Q4 earnings beats in smelters, avoid coal laggards.
